response.sql: WITH winners_by_hand AS (SELECT CASE WHEN p.bats IS NULL OR TRIM(p.bats) = '' THEN 'Unknown' ELSE p.bats END AS hand, COUNT(*) AS winner_count FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id GROUP BY 1) SELECT hand, winner_count, winner_count * 1.0 / SUM(winner_count) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM winners_by_hand ORDER BY hand;
